sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Genjutsu (Inhale, Tactile) Earth Release, Wind Release.

system.description:
You form a mass of dust particles in front of you, firing a wave of dust bullets. Each creature of your choice within a 30-foot cone, must make a Dexterity saving throw.

Critical Success: Affected creature takes half of 1d12 Earth Damage and 1d12 Piercing Damage.

Success: Affected creature takes half of 1d12 Earth Damage and 1d12 Piercing Damage and the affected creature is Dazzled until the end of their next turn.

Failure: Affected creatures takes 1d12 Earth Damage and 1d12 Piercing Damage and the affected creature is Sealed and Bruised.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but the affected creature takes 2d12 Earth Damage and 2d12 Piercing Damage.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, and both damage types by 1d12. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, increase ranks of Sealed by +1. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the size of the cone by +10 feet. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, increase ranks of Dazzled by +1. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the size of the cone by +10 feet.
